시편 130:1.content: A Song of degrees. Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Lord.

시편 130:2.content: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

시편 130:3.content: If thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

시편 130:4.content: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

시편 130:5.content: I wait for the Lord, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

시편 130:6.content: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

시편 130:7.content: Let Israel hope in the Lord: for with the Lord there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

시편 130:8.content: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
